meta.title: Mobilcab roadmap — what we ship, and in what order
meta.description: Mobilcab ships in stages: cut lists, nesting, CNC, team, then AI. Billing opens at M2. No fake dates — just order and status.

hero.label: Product roadmap
hero.title: We ship in stages — each one useful on its own.
hero.body: We don't promise “full CAD and CNC tomorrow.” We build in order: workshop basics first (design + cut lists), then the next stage only when the current one is stable on real projects. On the site, stages appear as M1–M5 — tap them anywhere to land here.

stages.title: Cut list — 3D design + parts list
stages.body: Design furniture in 3D, save to the cloud, and get the parts list — what you cut in the workshop. That's the foundation: without a cut list, the project isn't worth investing in. The app is free in this stage.

stages.title: Nesting + labels + quotes
stages.body: Lay parts on sheets, print labels, and work out costs so you can give the client a clear quote. That's also when billing opens: the Atelier / Producție / CNC plans. Founding Partners: 20% off list, 6 months from first payment.

stages.title: CNC export
stages.body: Machine files once nesting is solid. A repeatable flow you can rely on — not “every CNC in the world” on day one.

stages.title: Team and sharing
stages.body: Workshop work with roles, invites, and a view-only link for the client — without opening the whole shop to them.

stages.title: AI + renders
stages.body: A layout assistant and visuals for presentations. Extras on separate plans — they don't block the core workshop stages.

a: They're the product stages, in order. M1 = Cut list (3D design + parts list — the foundation now, free). M2 = nesting, labels and quotes — when billing opens (Atelier / Producție / CNC; FP: 20% off). M3 = CNC export. M4 = team and sharing. M5 = AI + renders.
Elsewhere on the site, wherever you see M1–M5, you can tap them to jump here to that stage.
So you get something useful in the workshop sooner — not a half-finished tool on every front. Each stage has to stand on its own before we open the next one.
At M2 — when nesting, labels and quotes are ready. Until then the app is free. Founding Partners on the waitlist get 20% off list for 6 months from first payment; later subscribers pay list price.
After design, cut lists and nesting are stable on real projects. CNC export without reliable nesting only frustrates you at the machine — that's why it's stage three (M3), not stage one.

items.q: Can I use design only for now?
a: Yes. M1 (Cut list: 3D design + parts list) is the foundation we launch first. You can work with it without waiting for nesting, CNC or AI.

cta.title: Try the foundation now
cta.body: Design and cut lists — the next step when you're ready.
